method: max positive directional causal 20-40 ms wheel slope from pulse request to observed IQ unload (exit request if unload missing), multiplied by 1.3 plus 0.5 m/s^2; includes failed attempts
limitations: Same-car evidence, not a physical acceleration ceiling or a guaranteed stopping deadline. No extrapolation to unseen speed/current pairs. Rebuild for a changed A baseline or operating conditions.
